title: Akiyama Mizuki — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay... I think we're supposed to meet here...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mizuki! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, An! Thanks for waiting... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello. Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui! You're here too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Since we're here to celebrate your birthday, I also invited Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ahh, I see.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I actually invited Tenma, Toya and the others too. Unfortunately, they couldn't make it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It won't be as lively as it could've been, but there's no need to worry.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a director, I'll be sure to make this birthday a fun one for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, as for the plan. How about we do whatever you'd like to do, Mizuki? Does that sound alright?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, hold on. That sounds like we're just hanging out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose it does when you put it that way. But it's not a bad idea, no?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I dunno.
I'm pretty hard to please.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha. Looks like the star of the day has high standards. Well, you can count on me to keep the fun going.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmmm. Alright, if you say so. I expect to be blown away.
Accessory Shop

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, check out this ribbon! Isn't it similar to the frills on the dress your sister made?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! It totally is! This would go so well with that dress!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, look at this really cute barrette! Don't you think this fluffy lace would go perfectly with the dress?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, I didn't even see these! Yeah, it's super cute. It'd totally match!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehehe. It's a gift precious to me, so of course I want to do it justice!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah! Sorry, Rui! We totally got ahead of ourselves!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: S-Sorry!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, it's alright. I was enjoying myself in my own way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Were you always interested in accessories or something?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I simply was wondering how could I use them in a show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Namely, what sort of effects I could achieve by building devices into them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that's what you meant...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm. With this pendant, I could use that circuit board. Actually, perhaps that other one instead. Which would mean, as for effects...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Well... I guess as long as you're having fun...
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yay! I achieved a full combo♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. How'd you like that? I nailed that so hard you must be speechless!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You and everything on the screen moved so fast that I couldn't even keep up! I don't really get it, but you're really good!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It looked like a very difficult song. To clear it perfectly really is a testament to your skill.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Reactions as expected, check and check! I love rhythm games. I just can't help but get sucked in playing my favorite songs!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, what kind of games are you two good at?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's see. Oh! I'm pretty good at shooting games!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Shooting? Like the shooting with a weapon kind?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't usually play video games, but I'm pretty good at those.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I had to say, tabletops might be more my forte. Particularly, card games or board games.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! I can totally see that! Alright then, let's play one of those next! I'm still gonna win!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, now that sounds interesting.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey! Hold up! Why do I have a feeling that I'll be designated loser when that happens?!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks for today, you two! I had so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha! I'm glad! I guess I'll take it that you were satisfied?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup, you can say that again! Thanks for the idea, Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, it was my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Once again! Happy birthday, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha, it's a little embarrassing having you say it directly to my face.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Blush all you want. This is the one day out of the whole year I get to do it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I better head off soon... Sorry! I've gotta meet my Dad after this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. Thanks for today! Let's hang out again sometime!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I suppose we should start heading home too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, there's one place I'd like to stop by. Would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, sure...
carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? This is where I worked part-time for a day a while back... Did you have something to do here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, I was requested to bring you here. I'll be heading off now, but please do sit down and relax.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Rui, what's going on?
Ready...now!
Happy birthday!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome, Mizuki! Behold the venue that will host your nighttime birthday celebration♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, huh?! My what now?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had a feeling you'd say that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The thing is... We were all invited to celebrate your birthday too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we couldn't all make it during the day... But we found out that we're all free from the late afternoon!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! And then that's when Rui suggested that we throw a surprise party for you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I didn't realize...
I can't believe Rui actually had something else in the works.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now, without further ado! Please let us celebrate your birthday with you too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know that you tune in to our streams quite a bit, so we prepared a segment for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've named this special segment, “A Happy Birthday with MORE MORE JUMP!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were discussing how it'd be fun to do this segment together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh my gosh! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We wanted to have lots of fun with you, so we brought a bunch of stuff over!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've got playing cards, board games and more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't know if we'll be able to get through all of these, though.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We also have a special birthday menu lined up as well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember those Mount Everest parfaits? I spiced it up and made a special birthday version just for you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's super yummy, so I hope you look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Everyone...
Aww, this is all too good to be true!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank you so much! Okay! I can't wait to enjoy all of this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Mizuki! I'm so glad that you liked our surprise!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That Mount Everest parfait that Saki made really was amazing. Mizuki looked so happy taking all of those photos.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be honest, that parfait went beyond Mount Everest. Mizuki even had to stop eating halfway.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha. I thought the more the better, but I might have gone overboard.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We ended up having to help finish it off, didn't we? That parfait was really delicious.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was really fun sharing that massive parfait all together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sure that made a wonderful birthday memory, though. I'm glad Mizuki enjoyed the Happy Snacker too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Playing those board games with everyone was so fun too! Let's do that again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd love to hear more about fashion from Mizuki too. Maybe I'll organize a day for the two of us to chat soon.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Akiyama. I heard that you spent quite a lively birthday. I'm glad that you had an amazing time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So am I! However, don't be satisfied just yet! We'll be giving you a celebration to make up for our absence tenfold.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will be planning a show with Toya, Azusawa and Akito! There's no better way to put a large smile on your face than this, of course!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm not sure if I'll do well in theatre, but... I-I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, wait a second. When did I get dragged into this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha. Oh, c'mon! Let's do the birthday show! Tenma, can I be a part of it too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, I'd like to offer my services as well. Let's all put together an amazing birthday show for Mizuki, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Mizuki. I freaked out a little when you came in while we were preparing, but I'm glad we got to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sure the excitement from receiving the dress couldn't wait.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki sent a lot of photos of the dress, as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just realized that I should've taken photos at the party. Mizuki was having so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's okay, I took some. It seems like a certain someone forgot to take any photos of themselves.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right. Thank you.
I hope Mizuki's sister likes them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So many people celebrated my birthday with me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sis, Kanade, Miku and the others, and then An, Rui, Saki and everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It made me so happy knowing how much everyone thought about me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't forget about you guys! I really appreciate your wishes too! Thank you so, so much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's make more memories together♪
